cases.name: Feeding Our Future
cases.description: Largest pandemic fraud case in US history. Federal child nutrition program funds allegedly stolen through fake meal sites claiming to feed thousands of children who never received meals.
cases.latestUpdate: Aimee Bock ordered to forfeit $5.2M. Trials ongoing, 28+ convicted so far.

cases.name: CCAP Daycare Fraud
cases.description: Minnesota's Child Care Assistance Program investigated for widespread fraud. HHS froze all payments to Minnesota. Viral video by Nick Shirley exposed daycares still receiving payments despite being closed.
cases.latestUpdate: Trump administration froze childcare funds. House Oversight Committee announcing hearings. DCYF conducting site visits.

cases.name: Housing Stabilization Services
cases.description: Program terminated after investigators found widespread billing fraud. Providers allegedly billed for services never rendered to disabled and elderly Minnesotans.

cases.name: Minnesota Child Care Fraud Investigation
cases.description: Investigation into alleged child care fraud in Minnesota, involving federal and state agencies
cases.latestUpdate: Federal audit reveals oversight flaws in Minnesota’s child care payments
cases.sourceArticle: Federal audit reveals oversight flaws in Minnesota’s child care payments - FOX 9 Minneapolis-St. Paul
